answer: Register every completed job as a pigment fingerprint, a hash of task, output and timestamp, on a public basalt ledger. When two identities show colliding fingerprints across different tasks, auditors confirm the match; the clone's epoch earnings go to the reporter and its jetty access is revoked for 6 epochs. Keeping one fingerprint active costs 20,000 POA per identity per epoch, so 1,000 fakes pay 20,000,000 POA while one honest agent pays 20,000 POA once. Limitation: honest agents doing identical template work can trigger false collisions.
